name: The Lantern Festival of Fallen Stars
description: A nighttime celebration where paper lanterns made from captured starlight float above a mountain village, their gentle glow painting the snow-covered rooftops in shades of gold and silver.
prompt: A breathtaking night scene of a snow-covered mountain village with hundreds of glowing paper lanterns made from captured starlight floating gently above traditional wooden houses, warm golden and silver light reflecting off the snow, distant mountains silhouetted against the starry sky, soft aurora borealis in the background, peaceful and magical winter festival atmosphere, highly detailed, cinematic composition, fantasy art style
caption: Wishing upon lanterns made of starlight... 🌌✨ What wish would you send floating into the night?
